crop-pdf.formula:
new x = left % × page width
new y = bottom % × page height
new width = page width × (1 − left % − right %)
new height = page height × (1 − top % − bottom %)
howTo: Click “Choose PDF file” and select the PDF you want to crop.
Enter how much to trim from each edge as a percentage (0–40%).
Choose whether to crop all pages or a specific page range.
Click “Crop PDF” and check the before/after dimensions.
keyFacts: Cropping sets each page's CropBox — the rectangle that tells readers which part of the page to display.
The CropBox is measured in points from the bottom-left corner: an A4 page is 595.28 × 841.89 points.
Percent margins adapt automatically: 10% trims the same relative border on A4, Letter and custom sizes.
Cropping never deletes content — it only changes the visible window, and the reset option restores it fully.
Page ranges are inclusive: from 3 to 5 crops pages 3, 4 and 5.

crop-pdf.workedExample:
Crop 10% from every edge of an A4 page (595.28 × 841.89 pt):
new width = 595.28 × (1 − 0.10 − 0.10) = 595.28 × 0.8 = 476.22 pt
new height = 841.89 × (1 − 0.10 − 0.10) = 841.89 × 0.8 = 673.51 pt
The visible page shrinks from A4 to 476 × 674 pt, centered on the original.
